description: Reverse-ETL sink: keep a specific Notion page's properties (and optionally its markdown body) in sync with the first row of an upstream DataFrame. Property values are serialized based on the page's existing property types, retrieved via pages.retrieve at materialize time.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. One row (row_index) syncs to the target page's properties/body.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Notion.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

page_id.label: Page Id
page_id.description: Notion page ID to keep in sync (UUID with or without dashes).

properties_map.label: Properties Map
properties_map.description: Upstream column -> Notion property name. Leave empty to do a body-only sync via markdown_column.

markdown_column.label: Markdown Column
markdown_column.description: Optional column whose value (from row_index) is written to the page body as markdown, replacing the current content.

row_index.label: Row Index
row_index.description: Which upstream row to sync from. Defaults to 0 (first row).

name: Notion Page Sync
